svg.title: Exchange Three Tiles — Across the table
svg.desc: Top-down view of four seats: Player A at the bottom, B on the right, C at the top, D on the left. Each player has three face-down tiles. Arrows show passing across the table. Each player exchanges three tiles of the same suit and keeps the selection face down.
